issues.issueDescription: A race condition in the license validation routine allows a locally authenticated user to bypass license enforcement checks and enable restricted features.
issues.remediationSteps: Apply the concurrency fix from the vendor advisory and audit enabled feature flags.

issues.issueDescription: The configuration backup feature stores credentials in plaintext within the exported archive, exposing sensitive secrets to anyone with access to the backup file.
issues.remediationSteps: Encrypt backup archives and rotate any credentials that may have been exposed.

issues.issueDescription: An out-of-bounds write in the image parsing library can be triggered by a specially crafted file, resulting in a crash or potential arbitrary code execution.
issues.remediationSteps: Upgrade the image parsing library to the version that fixes the buffer boundary check.
